entries.speaker: Studying in the Library
entries.en: When you study in the library, time will pass,[n]but you will improve your [stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27]. Also,[n]during [clr 2]bad weather[clr 27], your focus will increase and[n]your [stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27] will improve even more.

entries.speaker: Studying in the Library
entries.en: At times, you may overhear students talking about[n]you, causing you to lose focus. Your [stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27][n][clr 2]may not increase as much[clr 27], but your [stIcon 3][clr 26][stLabel 3][clr 27] will[n]slightly grow instead.
